name: Shin Shin Natural Gas Company Limited
summary: Shin Shin Natural Gas Company Limited functions as a primary provider of natural gas services throughout Taiwan. Beyond its core distribution activities, the enterprise is also engaged in the manufacturing, sale, and international trade (import and export) of gas apparatus and components. Its clientele spans a diverse range, including residential users, commercial enterprises, and the service industry. The company, which originated in 1971, has its corporate headquarters situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
